title: Sr. Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**About SalesUP**

SalesUP is a B2B sales and GTM engineering firm working with enterprise clients across fintech, HR tech, payments, and logistics. We are looking for a sharp, self-driven HR & Talent Acquisition Specialist who can independently manage recruitment, build teams from the ground up, and support essential HR operations.

**Role Overview**

The primary responsibility of this role is to own end-to-end recruitment, build hiring pipelines, and ensure timely closure of open positions. The role will also involve supporting day-to-day HR operations, including attendance tracking, payroll coordination, and maintaining employee records across HR portals.

**Key Responsibilities1. Talent Acquisition & Recruitment**

* Own the complete recruitment lifecycle, from sourcing and screening to interviews, offer management, and onboarding.
* Build teams from 0 to 1 by developing effective sourcing strategies and hiring pipelines.
* Manage multiple hiring requirements and high-volume recruitment across different roles and projects.
* Source candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, recruitment vendors, referrals, and other relevant channels.
* Coordinate with hiring managers and leadership to understand requirements and prioritize hiring.
* Track recruitment metrics, maintain hiring reports, and share regular updates on pipeline progress and closures.
* Ensure a smooth candidate experience and timely communication throughout the recruitment process.
* Take complete ownership of hiring targets and deliver results with minimal supervision.

**2. HR Operations & Administration**

* Support monthly payroll processing by validating employee data, attendance, leave records, and salary inputs.
* Monitor attendance, leaves, login/logout records, and employee data across internal portals.
* Ensure employee information, joining dates, exits, and salary details are accurately updated across HR systems.
* Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to resolve attendance discrepancies, portal issues, and payroll-related queries.
* Maintain employee records and support onboarding and exit formalities.

**Requirements**

* Proven recruitment experience with a track record of successfully building teams from scratch.
* Strong understanding of the Indian hiring market, sourcing channels, and recruitment practices.
* Ability to independently manage end-to-end recruitment and multiple open positions.
* Strong sourcing, screening, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Basic understanding of payroll coordination, attendance management, and HR operations.
* Comfortable working with HRMS, attendance systems, spreadsheets, and recruitment portals.
* Self-driven, proactive, organized, and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
* International hiring experience will be an added advantage.

**What We’re Looking For**

Someone who takes ownership, works independently, and can build recruitment processes while ensuring essential HR operations run smoothly. The ideal candidate should be resourceful, detail-oriented, and capable of delivering hiring results without constant supervision.

usiness Development & Talent Acquisition

Role Overview

We are looking for an entrepreneurial and performance-driven **360° Recruitment Consultant** to spearhead both client acquisition and end-to-end recruitment delivery. In this dual-impact role, you will identify and onboard corporate clients who need hiring solutions, while directly managing the complete talent search and selection lifecycle to fulfill those mandates.

Key Responsibilities1. Client Acquisition & Lead Generation (B2B Sales)

* Identify, research, and prospect potential B2B clients (startups, SMEs, and mid-to-large enterprises) looking for recruitment and staffing support.

* Pitch recruitment service offerings, negotiate terms of business (service fee margins, replacement guarantees), and close Master Service Agreements (MSAs).
* Maintain ongoing client relationships to drive repeat business, account expansion, and referrals.

* Take detailed job briefings from clients to understand technical requirements, culture fit, compensation bands, and turnaround expectations.
* Source passive and active candidates across multiple channels (Naukri, LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, internal databases, and direct headhunting).
* Screen CVs, conduct preliminary behavioural and technical assessments, and prepare candidate submission summaries.
* Coordinate client-candidate interview rounds, manage feedback loops, and resolve candidate hesitations.
* Lead salary negotiations, extend offers, and manage candidate engagement up to day-one joining to minimise dropouts.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* **Experience:** 2–5 years of proven experience in an agency, consultancy, or staffing firm handling both business development and candidate delivery (360° recruitment model).
* **CRM & ATS Expertise:** Hands-on experience working with CRM systems (HubSpot, Zoho CRM, etc.) and recruitment applicant tracking systems (Zoho Recruit, Ceipal, Bullhorn, or similar).
* **Sourcing Skills:** Expertise in Boolean search strings, Naukri portal operations, LinkedIn Recruiter, and headhunting techniques.
* **Commercial Acumen:** Strong understanding of staffing business metrics, recruitment margins, contract negotiations, and client management.
* **Communication:** Exceptional verbal and written English communication, presentation, and objection-handling skills.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Marketing, or a related field.

Key Competencies

* B2B Lead Generation & Cold Outreach
* CRM Pipeline Management
* End-to-End Candidate Lifecycle Management
* Contract & Salary Negotiation
* Client Relationship & Stakeholder Management
* Time Management & Mandate Prioritisation

What We Offer

* Competitive base salary with an attractive, uncapped commission/incentive structure on both client acquisition and candidate placements.
* Fast-track career growth into lead/managerial roles.
* Collaborative and high-ownership work environment.

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹25,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

This role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work under pressure. The CoE Specialist (Center of Expertise) will play a crucial role in maintaining the stability and reliability of our IS/IT environment, while also driving continuous improvement initiatives to enhance our incident management processes.*

*We are looking for a skilled CoE Specialist on CRM and F&O with hands-on experience in Microsoft Dynamics CRM (D365 CE) and Finance & Operation to provide application support, maintenance, and enhancements. * Work closely with development teams for bug fixes and enhancements.
* Document solutions, known issues, and support procedures.
* Used to work in Shifts

**Required Skills:**

  

* Strong experience in Microsoft Dynamics CRM / D365 CE Support and D365 F&O.
* Knowledge of customization and configuration (entities, forms, workflows, plugins).
* Hands-on experience with Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience in solution deployment and environment management (Dev, UAT, Prod).
* Basic understanding of C#, JavaScript, Web APIs (for troubleshooting).
* Knowledge of integration with external systems.
Knowledge on Dual Write (CE* F&O),Data Management Framework (DMF) and Batch Jobs.

**Extra Skills That Set You Apart:**

  

* Experience and deep knowledge with **Java, Hybris, PL SQL, Magento, Shoppify**
* **ITIL4** Foundation certification
* Experience with the implementation and maintenance of **GenAI Solutions, Chat Bots and Machine Learning**

**We Offer You:**

We offer more than just a job. We put people first and inspire you to become the best version of yourself.

* Flexible work policies including core hours and options for working from home. Discuss with us during the recruitment process to understand what flexibility could look like for you!
* Genuine opportunities for career and personal development through ongoing training and constant career opportunities reflecting our conviction that people are our most important asset.
* Modern "smart office" locations providing agile workspaces. Our state-of-the-art campus is equipped with areas to co-create, network, and chill!
* International, dynamic & inclusive working environment with attractive additional benefits.
* The pride to work for a B Corp certified company and one of the world’s most trusted brands.

### **1. Employer Relationship Development**

* Identify Indian companies recruiting U.S. tax and accounting professionals.

Job Title: HR & Admin Manager Location: Vashi, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra Department: Human Resources & Administration Experience: 5-7 years Joining: Immediate joiners or candidates with a notice period of less than 30 days preferred Team Handling: Mandatory

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and proactive HR & Admin Manager to oversee the company's human resources functions and administrative operations. The ideal candidate should have strong experience in end-to-end HR operations, recruitment, employee engagement, payroll coordination, statutory compliance, office administration, and team management.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring smooth HR and administrative operations, maintaining compliance with applicable labour laws, developing HR processes, and supporting management in achieving organizational objectives.

Key Responsibilities

1. Human Resource Management

Manage end-to-end HR operations, including employee lifecycle management from onboarding to exit.

Develop, implement, and maintain HR policies, procedures, and employee guidelines.

Handle manpower planning and coordinate with department heads to understand hiring requirements.

Manage recruitment activities, including job postings, screening, interviewing, selection, and offer negotiation.

Ensure timely onboarding, induction, documentation, and background verification of new employees.

Maintain employee records, HR databases, attendance, leave, and personnel files.

Manage employee engagement initiatives, grievance handling, disciplinary matters, and conflict resolution.

* Coordinate performance appraisal processes, employee feedback, and training

and development initiatives.

* Handle employee separation, exit interviews, full-and-final settlement

coordination, and relieving documentation.

* Support management in workforce planning, retention strategies, and

organizational development.

2. Payroll & Compensation Management

* Coordinate monthly payroll processing, salary inputs, attendance, leave

adjustments, incentives, and deductions.

* Ensure accurate calculation and processing of salaries in coordination with the

payroll team or external consultant.

* Manage payroll-related documentation, salary revisions, and employee

compensation records.

* Coordinate preparation of salary slips, payroll reports, and other employeerelated

financial records.

* Ensure timely processing of full-and-final settlements and employee

reimbursements.

3. Statutory Compliance & Labour Laws

* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and employment regulations.
* Coordinate statutory compliance relating to PF, ESIC, professional tax, labour

welfare fund, gratuity, bonus, and other applicable requirements.

* Maintain statutory registers, employee documentation, and compliance records.
* Coordinate with consultants, auditors, and government authorities for

inspections, filings, and audits as required.

* Monitor changes in applicable labour regulations and ensure timely

implementation of necessary updates.

4. Team Management & Leadership

* Lead, supervise, and manage the HR and administration team.
* Allocate responsibilities, monitor deliverables, and ensure timely completion of

departmental activities.

* Guide team members on recruitment, HR operations, employee relations, and

administrative processes.

* Set team priorities, review performance, and provide coaching and feedback.
* Establish standard operating procedures (SOPs) to improve efficiency and

accountability.

* Coordinate with senior management and other departments to address

workforce and administrative requirements.

5. Office Administration & Facility Management

* Oversee day-to-day office administration and ensure smooth functioning of

office operations.

* Manage office facilities, housekeeping, security, maintenance, and other

support services.

* Handle procurement of office supplies, stationery, equipment, and

administrative requirements.

* Coordinate with vendors, service providers, landlords, and facility management

agencies.

* Monitor administrative expenses, vendor bills, budgets, and cost-control

initiatives.

* Ensure proper maintenance of office assets, inventory, records, and company

property.

* Coordinate travel arrangements, accommodation, meetings, events, and other

administrative activities as required.

* Ensure workplace safety, cleanliness, and adherence to company policies.

6. Attendance, Leave & HR Documentation

* Monitor employee attendance, punctuality, leave balances, and overtime

records where applicable.

* Ensure accurate maintenance of employee master data and HR documentation.
* Prepare and maintain HR reports, including headcount, attrition, recruitment

status, attendance, and leave reports.

* Maintain confidentiality and security of employee information.
* Ensure timely renewal and maintenance of employment-related documents,

licences, and administrative records as applicable.

7. Management Reporting & Coordination

* Prepare periodic HR and administrative reports for senior management.
* Provide updates on recruitment, manpower costs, employee turnover,

absenteeism, and team performance.

* Identify opportunities to streamline HR processes and improve operational

efficiency.

* Coordinate with Finance, Operations, and other departments for smooth

business functioning.

* Support management in implementing HR initiatives, policy changes, and

organizational improvements.

Required Skills & Competencies

* Strong leadership and team management skills.
* Good knowledge of HR operations, recruitment, payroll coordination, and

statutory compliance.

* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills.
* Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and conflict-resolution abilities.
* Good organizational, planning, and multitasking skills.
* Proficiency in MS Office, particularly Excel, and HRMS/payroll systems.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive employee matters

professionally.

* Strong vendor management, coordination, and administrative management

skills.

Educational Qualifications

* MBA/PGDM in Human Resources or a relevant postgraduate qualification

preferred.

Experience Requirements

* Preferably 8-10 years of relevant experience in HR and administration.
* Prior experience independently managing HR operations and office

administration.

* Hands-on team handling experience is mandatory.
* Experience coordinating payroll, statutory compliance, recruitment, and

employee relations.

* Experience working in a corporate office or a similar business environment

preferred.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Candidates currently based in Navi Mumbai, Mumbai, or nearby locations.
* Candidates who can join immediately or within 30 days will be preferred.
* Candidates who can independently manage both HR and administrative

responsibilities.

* Candidates with a proactive approach and the ability to work closely with senior

management.

Interested candidates may share their updated resumes along with their current

CTC, expected CTC, total experience, team size handled, and notice period.

Pay: ₹45,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Commuter assistance
* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* Mention your Current CTC, Expected CTC and Notice Period details

Supremus Angel is a fast-growing organization committed to excellence, innovation, and building strong, talented teams. We focus on hiring skilled professionals who align with our values and contribute to our long-term success.

**Job Summary**

Talent Acquisition Specialist will be responsible for managing end-to-end hiring processes, driving recruitment strategies, and ensuring timely closures for various positions. Recognized for our entrepreneurial approach for over 70 years, our team of approximately 24,000 employees takes an ownership mindset, collaborating with customers to redefine what's possible. Headquartered in Downers Grove, Illinois, Dover trades on the New York Stock Exchange under "DOV." Additional information is available at dovercorporation.com.

**Education:** B.Tech/M.Tech(E&C)

**Experience:** 4-7 Yrs

**Location:** Whitefield, Bangalore

**Roles and Responsibility:**

* Responsible to lead embedded design and development of the product
* To write firmware code for the product & integrate it to hardware of the product.
* To do the testing at system & product level

To deliver the assigned projects on time & with desired quality expected by OpC

* Must have extensive experience in coding using Embedded C Language- Structures, Pointers etc. Proven track record of New Product development.
* Understanding Real time system, MCUs, MPUs, Registers, IVT, ISRs etc. Experience with temperature control, position control, dispensing control. In depth Microcontroller PIC and ARM programing skills
* Develop front end user interfaces (HMI) including graphical and text based. Knowledge and use of OOP design principles, API design principles. Knowledge in low-power embedded systems, real-time operating systems (RTOS), and microcontroller-based firmware development.
In depth SPI, I2C, RS232 communication protocol experience. , TCP/IP : equipment level interfaces based on TCP/IP. The experience can be based off canned code. Should be capable of debugging issues arising in Boards, relate it to Firmware/ Hardware implication and resolve issues. Having used and be capable of designing hardware independent firmware/software using layered approach will be advantage. Experience using or at least good understanding on Real time systems and RTOS Concepts, should have followed Proper Coding guidelines. Good to have System design knowledge, choosing OS, Peripherals required, safety regulations required etc. Good to have knowledge or experience in designing and implementing adhering to software safety guidelines. Good to have Experience in GUI Design tools such as Qt, C# or similar tools.

description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

**About the Role**

  

The **Service Partnering Lead-ISC** role acts as the CTO’s senior technology partner and representative for an assigned Operating Unit Region and its relevant Commercial, QSC, R&D and Corporate Functions organisations and Technology Leaders. It maintains an end-to-end view of the CTO technology landscape, performance, dependencies, risks, investment and future requirements.

Acts as the principal CTO representative to assigned leadership teams. Connects business strategy with technology priorities, provides visibility and insight to inform decisions, and facilitates a coordinated CTO response to business needs. Offers trusted counsel, constructive challenge and an authoritative view of technology health (accountability remains with relevant product, service, project, risk, financial and operational owners).

**Role responsibilities**

  

**1. Strategic CTO Partnering**

Act as the principal CTO partner for the assigned Operating Unit Region and its Commercial, QSC, R&D and Corporate Functions stakeholders, including close working with Technology Site Partners and local technology leaders. Connect business strategy, site priorities and regional technology needs with CTO plans, make implications visible in decision-making, and provide trusted advice, constructive challenge and clear recommendations where priorities, demand, investment or delivery expectations need alignment.

**2. Integrated Service, Risk and Performance Assurance**

Maintain an end-to-end view of technology health across products, platforms, infrastructure, cyber, data, digital services, sites and delivery. Work with Technology Site Partners to understand site-level service experience, operational constraints, resilience concerns, local risk and compliance issues, and recurring pain points. Use service, operational, experience, financial and risk data to identify issues, trends and improvement opportunities, while ensuring material risks, compliance gaps, resilience concerns and dependencies are visible, tracked and escalated through the right forums.

**3. Portfolio, Investment and Technology Roadmap Visibility**

Provide an integrated view of strategic initiatives, portfolio delivery, lifecycle needs, demand, costs, funding, benefits and dependencies affecting the assigned region. Represent stakeholder needs in CTO discussions and highlight where technology, data, automation or emerging capabilities could improve performance, productivity, resilience or customer outcomes.

**4. CTO Orchestration, Governance and Executive Insight**

Bring together relevant product, service, engineering, cyber, data, architecture, portfolio and delivery teams to support a coherent CTO response to regional priorities. Facilitate governance, coordinate cross-functional escalation, track actions and provide the CTO with concise, evidence-based insight on stakeholder priorities, technology health, investment choices, material risks and matters requiring executive attention.

**Success in the role**

* Business and Technology Leaders recognise the role as a trusted adviser and effective route into CTO.

* Stakeholders have a clear, integrated view of technology plans, demand, investment, dependencies, risks and expected value.

* CTO teams respond coherently to stakeholder needs, with effective facilitation, timely escalation and fewer unresolved cross-functional issues.

* Agreed ITIL-aligned practices are consistently advocated, with process gaps and material non-adherence visible to accountable owners.

* Material risks, resilience concerns, delivery dependencies and investment choices are visible, tracked and escalated when required.

* The CTO receives timely, reliable insight and clear recommendations on matters requiring executive attention.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Senior-level experience working across complex, global technology environments and advising senior business or technology leadership teams.

* Proven ability to connect business strategy with technology priorities, provide insight into investment and delivery decisions, and advocate consistent adoption of ITIL-aligned service management practices.

* Broad understanding of enterprise technology, including products, platforms, infrastructure, cyber, data, architecture, digital services and delivery.

* Ability to build trusted executive relationships, provide credible counsel, influence decisions and mobilise appropriate teams without direct authority.

* Strong commercial, financial and portfolio awareness, with the judgement to assess demand, investment, benefits and supplier performance and advise accountable decision-makers.

* Strong analytical judgement, using service, financial, operational, risk and experience data to develop evidence-based insight and recommendations.

* Ability to work through ambiguity, balance competing priorities, constructively challenge stakeholders and maintain accountability for effective follow-through and escalation.

* Clear and influential communication, with an inclusive, collaborative approach across global, culturally diverse and matrix organisations.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

  

* ITIL Foundation or advanced ITIL certification.

* Experience within a multinational technology organisation.

* Experience of Digital Workplace, Infrastructure, Cloud and Enterprise Services.

* Knowledge of ServiceNow and service performance reporting.

* Experience supporting financial planning, demand management or technology portfolio governance.

* Experience driving continual service improvement and service maturity initiatives.

* Understanding of manufacturing, commercial, R&D or corporate technology environments.

Location – this role is based in: Bangalore, India

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. **2. GENERAL JOB SUMMARY**

  

Aptean is seeking a multidisciplinary Experience Designer with a specialism in website personalisation. You will design experiences on Aptean.com that help visitors discover relevant solutions and take the right next step, adapting content and interactions to audience needs, industry, intent and customer relationship where reliable information is available.

  

Your remit spans UX, UI, content hierarchy and interaction design, from initial entry through subsequent pages and return visits. You will support a prioritised roadmap of more than 50 experiences, balancing commercial value, visitor needs and delivery effort. Working with Personalisation Specialists, the CRO Lead and content teams, you will take ideas through journey mapping, prototyping, implementation handover and improvement after launch.

**3. SCOPE**

  

Designs personalised variants and components across desktop, tablet and mobile while maintaining consistency with the Aptean.com design system and the default page. The role covers visual asset creation or adaptation, responsive and accessible design, build handover, pre-launch quality checks and collaboration with personalisation, CRO, product marketing and UX teams to deliver a high volume of detailed work on schedule.

**4. ORGANIZATION**

  

You will own experience design and design specifications, with mentorship and standards within Aptean Design Studio. Personalisation Specialists will own audience configuration and Optimizely implementation. The CRO Lead will lead test strategy and statistical evaluation, with your input on hypotheses and interpretation. Martech and development colleagues will own identity, data connections and technical performance. Content and product marketing partners will support messaging and accuracy.

The roadmap will be delivered in prioritised stages, with time for discovery, design, validation and iteration. Your contribution will be assessed through usable, accessible experiences, reusable patterns and evidence of progress against agreed journey and commercial measures, rather than the number of variants produced alone.

**5. PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

  

* Map personalised journeys across landing, industry, solution and product pages, maintaining relevant messaging and next steps as visitors navigate.
* Design for new visitors, returning visitors and recognised customers. Work with specialists to distinguish verified information from inferred interests and define appropriate experiences for each.
* Create responsive page variants and components, including forms, customer proof, recommendations and calls to action. Adapt graphics and product visuals to support audience needs.

* Prepare clear Figma prototypes and specifications for implementation in Optimizely, including interactions, content requirements and behaviour across screen sizes.

description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

The Contact Center Senior Developer will be responsible for planning, designing, developing, configuring, securing, monitoring, and supporting enterprise Contact Center solutions that meet business requirements and enable reliable, scalable, and well-governed customer engagement processes across voice, chat, chatbot, and digital channels. Specific responsibilities are:

* Create scalable designs, configurations, tests, and deployments of contact center capabilities across voice, chat, chatbot, routing, agent experience, reporting, and digital engagement channels.
* Architect solutions that balance scalability, performance, security, maintainability, customer experience, and business value.
* Define and maintain contact center configuration standards for queues, skills, routing, channels, agent profiles, business hours, IVR/chat flows, reporting, and governance.
* Provide technical leadership for conversational AI, orchestration, bot-to-agent handoff, attached data, multilingual flows, fallback handling, and customer-context transfer.
* Establish monitoring, alerting, logging, observability, and incident response practices that improve production stability and operational visibility.
* Integrate contact center platforms with enterprise systems using APIs, webhooks, middleware, events, secure authentication, and reusable integration patterns.
* Support integrations with multiple CRM technologies, knowledge, workforce, identity, analytics, and regional business applications as required.
* Manages large information technology vendors in the technical aspects of designing and developing contact center solutions
* Manage DevOps and release practices, including source control, CI/CD, environment management, testing, regression validation, deployment governance, and production readiness.
* Assess emerging contact center technologies and develop roadmap recommendations based on capability maturity, integration fit, risk, supportability, cost, scalability, and business value.

**Qualifications**
------------------
